findings.finding: The BCM54213PE Linux path is bcm54xx_config_init -> bcm54213pe_config_init -> bcm54210e_config_init -> bcm54xx_config_clock_delay for the model-specific RGMII delay portion.

The broader bcm54xx_config_init path also includes interrupt mask writes, APD/powerdown flag handling, RX refclk/DSP/LED/PTP/WOL paths, and WOL status reads; these are not all safe or relevant to a Talos discriminator.
Generic Linux read_status/aneg dependencies add MII_STAT1000, MII_CTRL1000, and MII_LPA context around the already accepted BMCR/BMSR/ANAR/ANLPAR status surface.
The contract separates read-only candidates from write targets and flags read side-effect risks for BCM54XX ISR and Broadcom shadow/AUX access.
No direct hardware proof is authorized because the smallest potentially distinct reads still need a source/static access contract and GPIO32 reset recovery remains blocked by persistent event state.
RGMII delay, APD, EEE, interrupt, BMCR lifecycle, and Broadcom shadow/MMD writes require future write/restore contracts if they are ever considered.
Link readiness, GPIO32 ownership/reset, BMCR autoneg retry, broad PHY/MAC configuration, packet I/O, networking, SSH, Phase 12.2, and phase transition remain rejected.
The accepted physical Ethernet link precondition remains accepted and is not re-asked.
